title: Quick-Fix German Long Beans Hash
description: A rich, molten, quick-fix German dish featuring Chinese long beans, dehydrated for a Mediterranean twist. Serve as a side or main course.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced bacon and cook until crispy, about 5 minutes.
Add the Chinese long beans and cook for 5 minutes, or until they start to soften.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Sprinkle the flour over the vegetables and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Gradually add the chicken broth, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the liquid has thickened.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
